data.explanation: This is an invoice (Rechnung) from an office supply company for toner and paper you ordered. It asks for payment of 156.91 € by the stated date. The invoice actually gives two different dates for payment (13.05.2026 and 20.05.2026), which is worth clarifying with the seller, but both have already passed relative to today. Pay the amount to the IBAN shown, using the invoice number as payment reference, as soon as possible to avoid a reminder (Mahnung) or late fees. Keep the invoice for your records — office supplies can sometimes be claimed as a work-related expense on your tax return.
